_readme: The Program page (/program/ and /es/program/), src/pages/program.njk. en and es must have the same keys. All plain text. Write dates, times, Zoom numbers and the email only as tokens ({date}, {time}, {dateEs}, {timeEs}…). The page's facts come from elsewhere: the sessions from schedule.json (listed once status is 'published' and sessions is not empty; until then the page shows the announced start, 'coming soon' and the end), the times in every zone from when.js, the Add to calendar links from calendar.js. timeline.kinds labels schedule.json's session kinds; zones.youTag shows on the visitor's own zone (app.js).
